-95.13320,29.53510.name: Center of Reproductive Medicine, LLP dba, SGF Houston
-95.13320,29.53510.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Vicki L. Schnell, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

38.11889,56.25861.state: 48th Central Scientific Research Institute Sergiev Posad, 141306, Russ, Russian Federation

What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-118.40000,34.01000.name: Kite Pharma (Gilead)
-118.40000,34.01000.desc: Sells CAR-T cell therapies, in which a patient’s own immune cells are removed, genetically rewritten to attack their cancer, and returned. It is the treatment that made engineered cell therapy an industry rather than a research programme, and the manufacturing runs one patient at a time — which is why the price sits in the hundreds of thousands and why capacity, not science, decides who is treated.

101.71200,3.15600.name: Malaysian Rubber Board
101.71200,3.15600.desc: Runs the breeding and biotechnology programme for natural rubber, a crop with no synthetic substitute for aircraft tyres and surgical gloves. Rubber trees take seven years to yield, so a breeding decision made now takes effect in the 2030s, and almost all of the world supply comes from a narrow genetic base collected in the 1870s.

-47.82080,-21.17670.name: FastBio
-47.82080,-21.17670.state: Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo — Supera Parque de Inovação e Tecnologia
-47.82080,-21.17670.desc: Founded in 2011 by a group of PhDs and based in a science park at Ribeirão Preto, selling gene synthesis, oligonucleotides, peptides, proteins, antibodies and a CRISPR platform to Brazilian universities, technology firms and industry. It describes itself as a leader in the DISTRIBUTION of biotechnology products and services, and its own gene synthesis page names GenScript as the partner whose technology performs the work. That is the entry. Brazil's DNA synthesis market was around $62 million in 2023, the largest in Latin America and about two per cent of the world's, and the comprehensive lists of firms that manufacture synthetic DNA contain no South American entry at all. Screening works because an order has to pass through a provider who reads the sequence and checks the customer; where the order is placed in Brazil and filled abroad, that check is made in the jurisdiction that manufactures rather than the one that will host whatever is built. A customer testimonial on the company's own front page describes a gene import that was very slow because of the funding agency's procedure, which is the same distance measured in weeks.
